title: Claude Cowork Projects Just Dropped... (Instant Upgrade)
description: Anthropic just dropped Projects inside Claude Cowork, and it changes how you use AI on your computer. Every time you opened Cowork, Claude started from scratch -- no memory, no context. Projects fix that. You create one once, point it at a folder, add your instructions, and now Claude remembers everything between sessions. You can even set scheduled tasks inside each project. One project for your YouTube channel, one for your business, one for client work -- each one is its own dedicated AI employee that never forgets what it's working on. Live now on Pro and Max plans.
